svg.aria-label: Tokens per run on the one question the code cannot answer, 21 runs. Without memory: 384,028, 461,868, 684,593 tokens, 0 of 3 right, median 461,868. With each of six memory engines, cheapest first, each against that median. Engram: 207,802, 234,842, 382,985, 3 of 3 right, median 234,842, 49% fewer. server-memory: 230,895, 235,006, 340,772, 3 of 3 right, median 235,006, 49% fewer. claude-mem: 290,273, 314,557, 337,273, 3 of 3 right, median 314,557, 32% fewer. Leteo: 154,469, 327,398, 370,348, 3 of 3 right, median 327,398, 29% fewer. mem0: 324,451, 390,714, 446,152, 3 of 3 right, median 390,714, 15% fewer. basic-memory: 369,167, 469,391, 666,401, 3 of 3 right, median 469,391, 2% more. On the question the code does answer, not drawn, the six medians run from 13% fewer to 21% more than without memory, Leteo's is 5% fewer, and every run was right.
